ui.help.title: Get help without following the sender’s instructions
ui.help.1: Stop replying and avoid sending further money or private information.
ui.help.2: Contact your bank through its official app or a contact you find independently.
ui.help.3: Keep the messages and transaction details for a trusted adult and the relevant reporting service.
ui.help.4: Ask a trusted adult for support. Getting tricked is not a reason to stay silent.

analyst.correct: That detail supports the tactic you identified.
analyst.wrongReason: The detail matters, but try a different reason.
analyst.fineWrong: Look again at what the sender asks the person to do.
analyst.fineCorrect: Good distinction: appearance alone is not evidence of a scam.
analyst.herringAny: This looks striking, but it does not establish the tactic.
analyst.context: Useful background. It is not a clue to pin by itself.
analyst.ordinary: An ordinary message. Look for the suspicious request elsewhere.
analyst.duplicate: You have already pinned this evidence.
analyst.linkOk: Those matching details connect the two sources.
analyst.linkAlready: You have already recorded that connection.
analyst.linkFail: Those details do not form a matching connection. Try another pair.
analyst.allFound: You have all required clues. You may find optional clues or build the board.
analyst.allFoundNoGold: You have all required clues. Build the evidence board when ready.
analyst.goldLeft: There are {{n}} optional clues still to find.
analyst.boardIntro: Reconstruct the sequence using the pinned evidence.
analyst.boardWrong: Consider what the sender was trying to achieve at this point.
analyst.fixIntro: Choose a response that breaks the pressure and protects the person.
analyst.fixCorrect: That response creates space for an independent check.
analyst.fixWrong: Think about which action keeps money and account access safe.
analyst.replayIntro: Review the pattern and take one useful lesson with you.
analyst.mystery: There are no guided leads here. Find the tactics using what you learned.
analyst.mysteryNudge: Ask what the sender wants, how they claim authority, and why they discourage checking.
analyst.break: A pause can help you see a message more clearly.
analyst.finalPrompt: Use your safeguards outside the game and ask for help when uncertain.
